messages.subject: Population level Overlap and Proximity analysis
parts:
Hello wanted to express my gratitude with all the help you have provided me thus far. I know you mentioned the meta function could be used to generate mean home ranges from a population.

I was wondering if there was something similar for comparing population home range overlap and from population proximity analyses.

Any clarifications would be greatly appreciated.

Sincerely,
Aidan

messages.author: 40fd627580dd34f5
messages.subject: Re: Population level Overlap and Proximity analysis
parts:
Hi Aidan,

meta() can calculate the mean Bhattacharya distance (-log of overlap) from a sample of independent 2x2 overlap estimates. We are doing this to compare encounters in an upcoming manuscript.

But if you have a set of N home ranges from which you calculate NxN overlaps, then I haven't coded that meta-analysis up, because the errors are correlated and you can get far more overlap estimates than home-range estimates, which would incorrectly shrink the standard errors if you don't account for the correlation.

Best,
Chris
